title: cosmea parviflora
intro: Cosmea parviflora, commonly known as the dwarf or small-flowered cosmos, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression, as well as protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Cosmea parviflora include its sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for promoting relaxation and relieving muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Cosmea parviflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
